title: Robot Pilot
description: At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality. Role Description: Tier 2 Robot Pilots are trusted, high-output robot teleoperators who reliably collect high-quality manipulation data using VR teleoperation systems. Pilots operate with minimal supervision, consistently meet data throughput and quality standards, and can troubleshoot routine issues (such as basic software workflow and lab operating issues). They also support researchers with executing evaluation protocols and providing clear feedback on robot and model behavior. Primary Duties ● Collect high-quality robot training data by teleoperating robotic systems using VR equipment and hand controllers; demonstrate manipulation tasks repeatedly and consistently. ● Meet daily performance expectations for data collection throughput, quality, and consistency (including correct task setup and complete metadata/notes). ● Follow task specifications and SOPs precisely, maintain discipline around experiment changes and “what changed” between sessions. ● Maintain a safe work environment and adhere to lab safety procedures at all times. ● Support evaluations by running structured evaluation protocols alongside researchers and accurately reporting results and issues. Additional Tasks: ● Troubleshoot and report issues with robot hardware/software and teleop tooling, capture relevant logs/notes and escalate with clear reproduction steps. ● Perform basic operational maintenance per SOP (workspace reset between sessions, calibration checks, battery swaps or component swaps as required). ● Review/annotate recordings as needed (lightweight review for quality checks, labeling support, or spot audits). ● Participate in process improvements to increase data collection efficiency, reduce downtime, and improve data quality. ● Occasional travel to customer/partner sites (domestic & international) to support on-site robot data collection, including operating in new environments, coordinating with site contacts, and following site-specific safety and security requirements. ● Occasional weekend overtime data collection (maximum one day per weekend), balanced with flexible scheduling and time off during the week. Required Qualifications: ● Strong VR / controller proficiency (VR gaming or similar real-time control experience). ● Ability to maintain focus while operating in VR for extended periods and follow detailed written/video instructions. ● Comfort working hands-on with robotics equipment in a lab environment; safety-minded and detail-oriented. ● Comfortable with Linux / command line (running programs with arguments, checking logs). ● Ability to debug routine issues and distinguish between environment/setup vs software vs hardware problems. ● Ability to write detailed bug reports when issues arise, document failure modes and participate in investigative efforts to diagnose and recover quickly. ● Reliable attendance and punctuality; able to work a fixed full-time shift (AM or PM). ● Basic technical literacy: comfortable navigating computer tools, documenting work, and communicating clearly. ● Able to stand/sit for extended periods, perform repetitive motions, and support physical reset tasks as needed (may include lifting/moving items up to ~30 lbs, squatting/standing during resets). Preferred: ● Experience with robotics systems, lab work, automation, manufacturing/assembly, or other precision technical work. ● Experience supporting structured experiments/evaluations with researchers or engineers. ● Experience collecting teleop demonstration data (robots, simulators, or other real-time control systems). title: Senior Product Designer
description: WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity. Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures. The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In . We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale. This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next. Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts. Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability. Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft. Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles. Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work. Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact. Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable. Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement). Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices. UX Research & Strategy Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis. Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions. Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on. Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone. Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs. Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics. Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go. Web & Brand Experience Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence. Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components. Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency. Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements. ROLE REQUIREMENTS Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work. Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy. Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite. Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability. Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries. Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions. Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers. Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English. A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup. Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to deepen our ML research capabilities in clinical oncology. This is a senior, research-oriented role for someone who wants to develop novel approaches to medical image analysis, treatment outcome prediction, and multi-modal clinical data integration - and see those methods reach real clinical settings.

You’ll work at the intersection of ML research and clinical application, collaborating closely with physicians, medical physicists, and experienced engineers with deep domain expertise. Together, you’ll develop methods that are scientifically rigorous and clinically meaningful. Your work will directly shape our product capabilities and contribute to peer-reviewed science.

What You’ll Do

Research & Method Development

  • Develop novel ML/DL methods for medical image analysis, including segmentation, lesion detection, longitudinal tracking, treatment response prediction, and outcome modeling

  • Design and conduct experiments to evaluate new approaches against clinical baselines and state-of-the-art methods

  • Stay current with the literature and propose research directions that advance Nucs AI’s product and scientific goals

  • Publish findings in top-tier venues (MICCAI, RSNA, JNM, Medical Image Analysis) and represent Nucs AI at scientific conferences

Clinical Translation

  • Collaborate with clinicians and medical physicists to ensure methods are grounded in clinical reality

  • Produce validated research outputs with documented performance benchmarks and clear handoff specifications for production engineering

  • Contribute to clinical validation studies and evidence generation for regulatory submissions

External Engagement

  • Collaborate with external academic research partners on joint studies

  • Support scientific diligence with pharma and clinical partners

  • Contribute to Nucs AI's scientific credibility in the field


What You Bring

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, medical image analysis, biomedical engineering, or related field

  • Strong publication record in relevant venues (medical imaging, clinical ML, computer vision)

  • Experience structuring and executing research collaborations with academic and clinical institutions

  • Deep expertise in deep learning architectures for image analysis (CNNs, transformers, U-Nets, etc.)

  • Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)

  • Experience working with medical imaging data (PET/CT, MRI, or similar modalities)

  • Strong statistical foundations - experimental design, hypothesis testing, survival analysis, and clinical biostatistics

Bonus Points

  • Experience with nuclear medicine imaging & dosimetry (PSMA-PET, FDG-PET, SPECT)

  • Expertise in treatment outcome prediction, survival analysis, or longitudinal modeling

  • Experience with multi-modal data integration (imaging + clinical + genomic)

  • Familiarity with clinical trial design and regulatory evidence requirements

  • Prior industry experience translating research into deployed products

  • Experience with graph neural networks, molecular representations, or drug-response modeling

  • Experience with Generative AI in medical domain

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact  – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity  – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators  – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds  – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility  – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside  – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

description: Unternehmensbeschreibung Wir von der mecom sorgen dafür, dass Menschen in Deutschland im Notfall zu jeder Zeit Warnmeldungen erhalten. Unsere in Deutschland einzigartige technische Infrastruktur ermöglicht es, Informationen sekundenschnell und manipulationssicher an die richtigen Empfänger zu versenden. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Sicherheitsbehörden, Bundeseinrichtungen, Nachrichtenagenturen, Medienhäuser und weitere Unternehmen. Wir sind ein Hidden Champion, der mit einem familiären Team jeden Tag Großes bewegt. Anspruchsvolle und sinnstiftende Projekte sowie der Einsatz neuester Technologien gehören für uns zum Alltag. Ab dem 01. Oktober 2026 suchen wir Verstärkung in Vollzeit (38h/Woche) für unser Team in Hamburg durch einen Senior Technical Service Manager (m/w/d). Der Job + Die Verantwortung Du übernimmst das Eskalations- und Incident-Management und stellst eine strukturierte Bearbeitung technischer Störungen sicher. Du berätst fachlich und technisch, analysierst komplexe Sachverhalte und entwickelst passende Lösungen. Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit über mehrere Bereiche hinweg und sorgst für eine klare, verlässliche Kommunikation. Du verantwortest das Kunden- und Lösungsmanagement und begleitest Anliegen bis zu ihrer nachhaltigen Klärung. Du stellst die fachliche Qualität sowie eine zuverlässige Unterstützung im Service sicher. Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Services mit. Du berufst bei Bedarf bereichsübergreifende Incident-Meetings ein und moderierst die weitere Abstimmung. Du leitest innerhalb definierter Supportprozesse technische Sofortmaßnahmen ein. Du empfiehlst geeignete Changes, um die Stabilität und Qualität des Betriebs nachhaltig zu verbessern. Du überprüfst die Servicequalität und achtest auf die Einhaltung etablierter Serviceprozesse. Du + Deine Stärken Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend und verfügst über ausgeprägte Moderationskompetenz. Du kannst technische Sachverhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht vermitteln. Du denkst analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert. Du zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung aus. Du bist bereit, Kunden und Projekte vor Ort zu betreuen und dafür zu reisen. Wir + Unsere Kultur Unser Antrieb: Professionalität. title: External Job Post
description: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. Who We Are This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA. What You’ll Achieve Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for Germany, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution. Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions. Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to German customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making. Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion. Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across Germany. Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions. Make agentic transformation central to the German GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption. Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value. Build “sell with” partner motions in Germany, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning. Establish Notion as a visible force in the German ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy. Represent the voice of German customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics. Create a talent destination in Germany by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent. Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution. Who We’re Looking For A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in Germany and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent. You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow. You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows. What You’ll Bring 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in Germany. Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams. Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics. Deep knowledge of the German enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics. Experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment. Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products. Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes. Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process. Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative. Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product. Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building. Fluency in German and English. Nice to Haves Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model. Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes. Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation. Location and Working Model Primary location: Munich, Germany. title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
description: <h2>At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.</h2> <p>Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for <strong>10,000+ businesses worldwide</strong>, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, <strong>millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day</strong>.</p> <p>We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.</p> <p>We're <strong>100 people</strong>, <strong>profitable</strong>, and have raised <strong>€18M in funding</strong> (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.</p> <p>We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.</p> <p>In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.</p> <p>We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.</p> <h3>This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code</h3> <p>You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.</p> <h3>Location &amp; work mode</h3> <p>Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. description: Die Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt sucht eine:n Data Analyst:in Fundraising (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Termin in Berlin (hoher Homeoffice-Anteil möglich) mit 35 Wochenstunden (Vollzeit) in Festanstellung. Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der kein Tier mehr für die Herstellung von Lebensmitteln leidet. Als Data Analyst:in Fundraising bist du Teil unseres sechsköpfigen Fundraising & Engagement-Teams. Der Bereich Fundraising & Engagement verbindet engagierte Menschen mit unserer Mission - als Spender:innen oder Freiwillige. Mit kreativen Aktionen sichert er die Finanzierung unserer Arbeit. Darüber hinaus optimierst du Fundraising- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen und stellst Datenqualität und Datenintegrität sicher. Damit sorgst du dafür, dass Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen datenbasiert geplant, segmentiert, ausgewertet und optimiert werden können. Mit KPI-Reportings, Tests und Analysen lieferst du belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Weiterentwicklung von Fundraising, Mobilisierung und Unterstützer:innen-Journeys. Im Einzelnen bedeutet das Du segmentierst und bereitest Daten für Fundraising- und Engagement-Maßnahmen vor Du entwickelst, pflegst und dokumentierst SQL-Abfragen und wiederkehrende Auswertungslogiken Du wertest Fundraising-, Engagement- und Mobilisierungsmaßnahmen entlang vereinbarter KPIs aus Du erstellst Monatsreportings und Dashboards mit den wichtigsten Steuerungskennzahlen Du bereitest A/B- und multivariate Tests vor, wertest sie aus und leitest Learnings ab Du analysierst Unterstützer:innen-Journeys, Zielgruppen und Segmente als Grundlage für Optimierung Du erstellst ad-hoc-Auswertungen und Handlungsempfehlungen für strategische Entscheidungen Dein Profil Idealerweise hast du einen Studienabschluss oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Fundraising, BWL, Controlling, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Statistik oder Data Science. Wir sind aber auch offen für Quereinsteiger:innen mit entsprechenden nachgewiesenen Qualifikationen und Referenzen. Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Digital Fundraising einer Non-Profit-Organisation. Du pflegst einen sicheren Umgang mit Instrumenten der qualitativen und quantitativen Datenanalyse inkl. Tracking- und Analyse Tools. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken und CRM Systemen. Du hast Erfahrung mit A/B- und multivariatem Testing. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Asana, monday.com, Jira oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen und nutzt sie, um Aufgaben, Abstimmungen und Projektfortschritte übersichtlich zu organisieren. (wir arbeiten mit Asana) Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig mit einer hohen Problemlösungskompetenz. Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weil z. B. eine Deadline näher rückt, bleibst du entspannt. Auf Unvorhergesehenes reagierst du flexibel und suchst passende Alternativen. Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen - auch wenn nicht alle an einem Ort sind. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung damit, KI-Tools reflektiert im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen und weißt, dass gute Ergebnisse klare Aufgabenstellungen, ausreichend Kontext und eine sorgfältige Prüfung brauchen. Du identifizierst dich mit unserer Vision, Mission und Kultur . Was wir dir bieten Eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Stelle auf 35-Basis: Als Teil des F&E-Teams bewirkst du direkt gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und verbesserst den Tierschutz. Home-Office-Möglichkeiten: Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und arbeitest mit flexiblen, familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten im hybriden Modell (Homeoffice & Büro). Professionelles Team: Kollegialer, offener Austausch in einem motivierten Team Hundefreundliche Büros inkl. „hundefreie“ Bereiche für Allergiker:innen sowie ergonomische Arbeitsplätze Attraktive Vergütung: Unbefristet, Jahresgehalt zwischen 45.996,00 € und 52.895,40 € (erfahrungsbasiert) + Bonuszahlungen Benefits: Cafeteria-Modell (finanzielle Vorteile, Deutschlandticket oder zusätzliche Urlaubstage), Zuschüsse zu Gesundheitsleistungen (z. B. B12 + D Bluttests) und betriebliche Altersvorsorge Weiterbildung: Aktive Förderung von Fort- und Weiterbildungen Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung bis zum 04.09.2026 per Bewerbungsbutton. GESIS – Leibniz-Institut für Sozialwissenschaften ist eine von Bund und Ländern finanzierte, international tätige sozialwissenschaftliche Einrichtung der Leibniz-Gemeinschaft. 

 
Wir suchen zum 01.10.2026 für den Standort Mannheim für die Abteilung Data and Research on Society, Team German Microdata Lab eine*n
 

Studentische Hilfskraft

(15,20 € / 16,09 € Stundenlohn, 36 Wochenstunden, befristet)
 

Die Beobachtung aktueller gesellschaftlicher Entwicklungen ist eine Kernaufgabe der Sozialwissenschaften. Die Abteilung Data and Research on Society unterstützt die Sozialforschung bei dieser Aufgabe, indem sie umfassende Daten und Tools zur Beschreibung und Analyse des sozialen Wandels bereitstellt.

Das German Microdata Lab (GML) wirkt als Schnittstelle zwischen empirischer Sozialforschung und amtlicher Statistik. Wir bereiten die Daten der amtlichen Statistik auf und bieten einen umfangreichen forschungsbasierten Service zu diesen Daten an.


Ihr Aufgabengebiet:

  • Mitarbeit bei der Aufbereitung und Dokumentation von Daten des European Labour Force Survey (EU-LFS)
  • Literaturrecherche und -aufbereitung
  • Unterstützung bei Forschungstätigkeiten


Ihr Profil:

  • Sehr sorgfältige, zuverlässige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Gute Kenntnisse in R, Stata oder einem anderen Statistikprogramm
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Aufbereitung und Analyse von Daten
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Interesse an einer längerfristigen Beschäftigung
  • Student*in eines sozialwissenschaftlichen BA- oder idealerweise MA-Studiengangs


Wir bieten:

  • Einblicke in die Arbeit eines Forschungsdatenzentrums und die Potenziale amtlicher Mikrodaten für die empirische Sozialforschung
  • Sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Regelungen zum mobilen Arbeiten
  • Sehr gute Bedingungen für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie 
  • Ganzheitliches Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und die vergünstigte Teilnahme am Sportprogramm der Uni 
  • Förderung Ihrer Kompetenzen durch Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen


Kontakt

Für weitere Informationen zu den Aufgabengebieten wenden Sie sich bitte per E-Mail () an Frau Dr. Andrea Lengerer. Bei Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess steht Ihnen Michaela Kurtov per E-Mail () zur Verfügung.


Wir haben Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann bewerben Sie sich bitte bis einschließlich 06.09.2026 über unser Online-Bewerbungsportal.
Die Kennziffer lautet: SHK_DRS_2026_015

title: Data Operations & Labeling Specialist (all genders)

We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We're focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe — today. About the team The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy. Your mission You are the crucial bridge between our raw field data, our external labeling partners, and our internal Machine Learning teams. Your mission is to ensure our AI models are trained on the highest quality data possible. You will own the day-to-day operations of the data labeling lifecycle: curating raw data, preparing annotation batches, managing vendor communication, and rigorously assessing the quality of incoming labels. If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and interested in the intersection of data operations and Computer Vision, this is the perfect place to start your career in AI. Responsibilities Own the day-to-day data labeling lifecycle: curate raw field data, create annotation batches, and prepare deliveries for external labeling companies. Serve as the primary point of contact for external data annotation vendors, clarifying edge cases and providing feedback on labeling guidelines. Conduct rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) assessments on incoming label deliveries, track error rates, and create performance reports. Support data curation efforts, filtering and selecting the most valuable sensor data (images, video, lidar) for model training. Work closely with ML Engineers to understand their data needs, edge cases, and specific Computer Vision requirements. Help maintain the data catalog by ensuring incoming datasets are properly tagged and logged. Qualifications Highly organized and detail-oriented: you can manage multiple data batches, vendor deliveries, and QA processes simultaneously without dropping the ball. Strong communication skills: you are comfortable coordinating with external vendors and writing clear, unambiguous instructions/guidelines. Basic understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning concepts (e.g., bounding boxes, segmentation masks, object tracking). Comfortable with basic scripting (Python) and data querying (SQL) to automate small tasks or filter data batches. Pragmatic problem-solver who enjoys bringing order to chaotic data deliveries. Fluent in English. Nice to have Familiarity with annotation formats (like COCO) and ML dataset structures. Previous experience using data annotation platforms (CVAT, Labelbox, Scale AI, etc.). title: Data Analyst (all genders)
description: Jede Entscheidung bei MUVN hängt an einer Zahl. Niemand soll sie suchen müssen. MUVN verbindet Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Kein neuer Fuhrpark, keine neue Logistik. Bessere Nutzung von dem, was ohnehin unterwegs ist. Unser Marktplatz wächst über Korridore, also über einzelne Strecken, die dicht genug werden, um von selbst zu tragen. Ob eine Strecke trägt, ist keine Meinungsfrage, sondern eine Messung. Dafür bauen wir das MUVN Brain: eine verbundene Schicht über unseren Systemen, in der Kennzahlen einmal definiert sind und Menschen wie AI-Agents dieselbe Antwort bekommen. Es wird immer mehr als ein System geben. Der Unterschied liegt darin, ob sie miteinander reden. Du baust das. Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Datenstelle, berichtest an unseren CFO und arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründungsteam, Marketing und Operations. Du erbst keine Datenplattform, du entscheidest, was sie wird. Und du beantwortest die Fragen, an denen bei uns Geld hängt: Welcher Korridor kippt als Nächstes. Wo verlieren wir Nachfrage. Welcher Kanal bringt Matches statt Downloads. Du arbeitest dabei AI-First: AI übernimmt die Ausführung, dir gehören Intention, logisches Denken und Korrektheit. Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Vollzeit 🚀 Aufgaben Eine Wahrheit, nicht fünf Du definierst unsere Kernkennzahlen über den gesamten Funnel, einmal verbindlich, mit klarer Namenskonvention und einer Definition pro Metrik. Teile davon existieren bereits, sie sind nur nirgends operationalisiert. Du gleichst die Quellen ab, erklärst Abweichungen und sorgst dafür, dass eine Frage genau eine Antwort hat, egal wer sie stellt. Den Marktplatz messbar machen Unsere Analyseeinheit ist der Korridor, nicht die Stadt und nicht das Land. Du machst Angebot, Nachfrage, Fill Rate und Time-to-Match auf dieser Ebene sichtbar, inklusive der Fälle, die in keinem Standard-Funnel auftauchen. Ein Fahrer, der nichts findet, ist bei uns ein Signal, kein fehlender Datenpunkt. Das MUVN Brain bauen Heute: direktes SQL, Python-Skripte, API-Pulls. Du überführst das in einen leichtgewichtigen, verbundenen Stack und entscheidest über Architektur und Tools, vom Warehouse über den Transformations-Layer bis zum BI-Tool. Jedes Werkzeug kommt an dem Punkt rein, an dem es seine Kosten verdient, nicht früher. Lieber fünf verlässliche Modelle als fünfzig halb vertraute. Pipelines, denen man vertraut Du integrierst unsere Quellen mit Pipelines, die idempotent, testbar und dokumentiert sind. Du baust Validierung zwischen den Quellen und fängst Diskrepanzen ab, bevor sie ein Meeting erreichen. Wenn etwas bricht, findest du die Ursache statt das Symptom und planst Backfills mit Prüfung davor und danach. Analysen, die Entscheidungen tragen Wiederkehrendes Management-Reporting, Kohorten, Retention, Pricing, Funnel, Marketing-Performance Ende zu Ende. Ad-hoc-Fragen beantwortest du schnell. Die, die immer wiederkommen, überführst du in Self-Serve-Reports, damit das Team sich selbst bedient. Das Team unabhängig von dir machen Du nimmst Anforderungen von Gründern, Marketing und Operations auf und übersetzt sie in Modelle, die wiederverwendbar sind. Du dokumentierst Definitionen, Annahmen und Sonderfälle dort, wo sie hingehören, im Code und in der Doku, nicht in deinem Kopf. Datenfragen sollen nicht bei dir enden. AI-Agents als Teil des Systems Du baust und iterierst Agents für klar umrissene Aufgaben: wiederkehrende Reports, Dokumentation, Datenqualitätschecks. Du pflegst die maschinenlesbaren Kontextdateien, die unser Brain überhaupt erst nutzbar machen, mit unseren Konventionen, Definitionen und Domänenregeln. Du prüfst, was AI produziert, bevor es zählt. Die Korrektheit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool. Qualifikation Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst:in, Analytics Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und schon einmal ein Reporting von null aufgebaut, nicht nur eines gepflegt. SQL ist für dich Handwerk, nicht Hürde: Window Functions, CTEs, Query-Optimierung, und genug Tiefe, um einen Execution Plan zu lesen und ein Performanceproblem selbst zu finden. Python nutzt du für Analysen und Pipeline-Arbeit. Was diese Rolle von klassischer Analyse unterscheidet: Du bekommst keine Tickets. Du bekommst Entscheidungen, die anstehen, und findest selbst heraus, welche Zahl sie tragen muss, wer sie liest und was es dazu schon gibt. Was bei uns funktioniert: Du fragst zuerst, welche Entscheidung an der Zahl hängt, bevor du die erste Query schreibst. Du formulierst eine Hypothese, bevor du sie prüfst, und änderst sie, wenn die Daten etwas anderes sagen. Du merkst, wenn eine Zahl zu gut ist, um wahr zu sein, und gehst ihr nach, bevor sie in ein Meeting kommt. Du arbeitest eigenständig und meldest dich, wenn etwas klemmt, nicht erst im Wochenmeeting. Du misst dich selbst an Ergebnissen, bevor es jemand anderes tut. Du dokumentierst so, dass die nächste Person dich nicht fragen muss. Du denkst in Kosten, bei Compute, Speicherung und Pipeline-Design, und handelst danach. Du teilst, was du weißt. Wissen, das nur bei dir liegt, ist bei uns ein Risiko, kein Vorteil. Solides Analytics-Fundament: Kohorten, Funnels, Unit Economics und statistisches Grundverständnis. Praxiserfahrung mit Produkt- und Marketing-Analytics-Tools wie Mixpanel, GA4, Mobile Attribution oder Vergleichbarem. Engineering-Grundprinzipien auf Datenarbeit angewendet: Modularität, Idempotenz, Testbarkeit als Default. Datenschutzbewusste Modellierung ist für dich selbstverständlich, wir arbeiten mit Zahlungs- und Personendaten. AI-gestützte Workflows sind dein Alltag, mit voller Verantwortung für das Ergebnis. Ein Plus, kein Muss: dbt oder ein Modern Data Stack, den du selbst eingeführt hast. Erfahrung mit Payments-Daten. Marktplatz- oder Plattformhintergrund, also Liquidität, Take Rate, Angebots- und Nachfragedynamik. Early-Stage-Erfahrung, du hast schon ohne Playbook gearbeitet. Deutsch und Englisch fließend. Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss. Benefits Dein Marktplatz, deine Zahlen: echte Ownership von Tag 1 Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Arbeite, wann es für dich am besten passt Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: kein HR-Filter, keine Hierarchie dazwischen Karriereperspektive: baue langfristig dein eigenes Team auf, in DACH und Europa Hybrides Arbeiten & Remote: Flexibilität ist bei uns Programm Offsites mit dem Team: Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr Free MUVN Rides: Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren Corporate Benefits: Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops Mehr Infos zu unseren Benefits und unseren Firmenwerten findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Schick uns deinen CV und zwei, drei Sätze dazu: Welche Kennzahl würdest du bei uns als Erstes verbindlich definieren, und warum ausgerechnet die? So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit unserem CFO, dann eine fachliche Session an einem anonymisierten Fall aus unserem Marktplatz, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team. Fragen? Direkt an Katharina. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a versatile Senior Accountant to serve as a key bridge between our newly established Berlin manufacturing facility and our US financial operations. In this dual-impact role, you will lead the cost accounting workflows and local compliance for our German entity (GmbH) while simultaneously supporting global cost accounting tasks, cross-border subsidiary reconciliations, and capital expenditure tracking. You will partner with operational leaders to establish scalable standard costing methodologies, maintain inventory integrity across multiple locations, and ensure seamless financial alignment between EMEA and US teams. Ideal candidates are detail-oriented professionals with background in multi-entity global structures who thrive in cross-functional environments.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partners with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.</li> <li>Leads monthly close processes for GmbH inventory, including raw materials, WIP, and finished goods reconciliations, while overseeing physical cycle counts and analyzing adjustments.</li> <li>Ensures local accounting activities comply with German GAAP (HGB), prepares cost breakdowns for German R&amp;D tax incentives (e.g., <em>Forschungszulage</em>), and manages financial documentation for local government grants and subsidies.</li> <li>Manages PCard reconciliations for lab equipment and flight materials while reviewing capital expenditure vs. operational expenses (CIP/Expense classifications) for the German entity.</li> <li>Serves as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off, high-volume periods, and initial US-hours coverage through cross-training on US month-end workflows.</li> <li>Reviews and clears consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.</li> <li>Maintains costs associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes while tracking movements across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.</li> <li>Assists in labor capitalization tracking across internal software development, satellite construction, and commissioning efforts.</li> <li>Performs purchase price variance (PPV), production variance, scrap, and Excess &amp; Obsolete (E&amp;O) analysis while preparing balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and accrued purchases/prepaid manufacturing schedules for US and EMEA operations.</li> <li>Supports internal and external audits across US GAAP, local German GAAP, and SOX controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4 to 6 years of relevant cost accounting experience in a manufacturing or high-tech operational environment.</li> <li>Experience with inventory controls and multi-entity global structures.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German <em>Ausbildung</em>, e.g., <em>Industriekaufmann/-frau</em>, with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).</li> <li>Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.</li> <li>Professional fluency in both English and German.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB).</li> <li>Direct hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>November 13, 2026 at 11:59p PT</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging.&nbsp;<br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.&nbsp; If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!&nbsp; At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.&nbsp; We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.&nbsp; We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Planet is an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12.pdf">Know Your Rights.</a></p> <p><strong>Accommodations:&nbsp;<br></strong>Planet is an inclusive community and we know that everyone has their own needs. Your message will be confidential and we will be happy to assist you.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy</strong>: By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/#california">Planet Data Privacy Notice for California Staff Members and Applicants</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy (European Applicants):</strong> By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/">Candidate Privacy Notice GDPR Planet Labs Europe</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>AI in Our Interviewing Process</strong>: Planet is committed to providing an exceptional interview experience for all candidates. description: <h3><strong>Position Overview:</strong></h3> <p>As an Account Executive with Diligent, you'll be at the forefront of driving revenue growth, deepening customer engagement, and shaping the future of how businesses utilise our cutting-edge solutions. Success in this role means expanding product adoption among current customers and introducing new clients to our platform. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role that demands strategic vision, proactive relationship-building, and relentless pursuit of excellence. You’ll be responsible for everything from engaging prospects and managing a robust pipeline to delivering accurate forecasts and closing deals. description: ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities. Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations. As our Engineering Team Lead (f/m/d) , you combine strong people leadership with hands-on technical expertise to guide and grow a high-performing team. title: Senior Technical Product Manager (IntelliJ Kotlin Plugin)
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. The Kotlin plugin for IntelliJ IDEA is where language meets experience — it's how hundreds of thousands of developers write, navigate, refactor, and understand Kotlin code every day. Being able to continuously improve it means understanding the language deeply, using the product daily, and deeply caring about Kotlin developers.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who will own the Kotlin-in-IDE experience end to end. This is a deeply hands-on role. You will experiment with Kotlin in IntelliJ based IDEs every day, maintain reference projects that double as regression canaries and demo showcases, build prototypes with AI coding agents, analyze users feedback and talk to users. You won't manage from slides — you'll manage from the editor.</p> <h3><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the product vision for the Kotlin plugin: fast, correct, and trustworthy IDE support that evolves with the language.</li> <li>Use IntelliJ IDEA with the Kotlin plugin daily — dogfooding features, catching regressions, and validating the developer experience first-hand.</li> <li>Maintain and develop reference Kotlin projects that serve as showcases for new features, material for conference demos, and a living test bed for DX quality.</li> <li>Build prototypes and proofs-of-concept using AI coding agents to explore and validate new capabilities.</li> <li>Own and continuously adapt the plugin roadmap across short-term release goals, mid-term initiatives, and longer-term Kotlin ecosystem related projects.</li> <li>Align plugin planning with Kotlin compiler releases, IntelliJ IDEA release trains, and Android Studio constraints.</li> <li>Make explicit trade-offs and say "no" when cost, risk, or maintenance burden outweighs user value.</li> <li>Define problem statements, success criteria, and scope for features — then collaborate with engineers to validate and refine.</li> <li>Represent core Kotlin personas — JVM backend developers, library authors, Android and Multiplatform teams — and prioritize recurring pain points: false positives, slow analysis, unreliable refactorings, onboarding pain points,&nbsp; AI agents integrations.</li> <li>Run a consistent pipeline of monthly user interviews to ground decisions in real workflows.</li> <li>Coordinate with Kotlin language team, Developer Advocates, framework partners, Marketing, and other JetBrains teams.</li> <li>Create external visibility through what's-new posts, Kotlin User Groups meetup talks, and feature previews at events like KotlinConf, Spring I/O, Devoxx and others.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We're looking for someone who:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Has professional software development experience in Java or Kotlin (this is a must).</li> <li>Has 5+ years of experience in technical product management or a comparable role in a complex technical domain.</li> <li>Is a hands-on product person who lives in the product, not someone who operates through reports and meetings alone.</li> <li>Has experience with AI coding tools and agents, and curiosity about how they reshape developer workflows.</li> <li>Can define clear roadmaps with problem statements, success criteria, and explicit trade-offs.</li> <li>Has strong communication skills in English — written and spoken — for both technical peers and executive audiences.</li> <li>Is ready to represent the product externally at conferences, in blog posts, and in community interactions.</li> <li>Takes developer experience personally — not as an abstract metric, but as something they feel in their own daily workflow.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We'd be especially thrilled if you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Have experience developing IntelliJ plugins or working with the IntelliJ Platform SDK.</li> <li>Have built or contributed to evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, or quality measurement systems.</li> <li>Have given technical talks or published content aimed at developer audiences.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why join JetBrains?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. description: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for Germany, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. Germany is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business. As General Manager, Germany, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the German business. You will lead through frontline managers and partner closely with Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Marketing, Professional Services, Channel, RevOps, and Product to build one unified country team. This is a builder-leader role for the AI and agentic era. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in Germany: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI. This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA. What You’ll Achieve Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for Germany, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution. Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions. Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to German customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making. Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion. Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across Germany. Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions. Make agentic transformation central to the German GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption. Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value. Build “sell with” partner motions in Germany, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning. Establish Notion as a visible force in the German ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy. Represent the voice of German customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics. Create a talent destination in Germany by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent. Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution. Who We’re Looking For A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in Germany and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent. You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow. In-office Anchor Days: Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays; regular customer, partner, and regional travel as needed. title: Customer Success Associate - Renewable Energy
description: Customer Success Associate – Renewable Energy Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Customer-Success-Teams. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industrieunternehmen mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit unserem integrierten Ansatz aus Energieversorgung, moderner Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligenter Optimierung des Energieverbrauchs helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen. Als Customer Success Associate unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen dabei, den vollen Mehrwert aus unserem nachhaltigen Produktportfolio zu ziehen. Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Betreuung, koordinierst wichtige Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich mit trawa arbeiten. Das Team Unser Customer Success Team begleitet Kund:innen von der ersten Anfrage bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft – mit dem Ziel, echten Mehrwert zu liefern, Wachstum im Bestand zu treiben und exzellenten Service zu skalieren. Wir stehen unseren Kund:innen nicht nur operativ zur Seite, sondern beraten sie auch aktiv zu Fragen rund um den Energiemarkt – damit sie in einem komplexen, volatilen Umfeld die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Operations zusammen und bist mittendrin, wenn es darum geht, wie trawa seine Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich macht. Deine Aufgaben Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust unsere Kund:innen persönlich und sorgst dafür, dass sie langfristig zufrieden und erfolgreich mit unseren Produkten arbeiten. Onboarding begleiten: Du unterstützt neue Kund:innen bei ihrem Einstieg in das trawa-Universum, koordinierst den Onboarding-Prozess und begleitest die Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle benötigten Informationen vorliegen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen eingebunden sind. Teamübergreifend arbeiten: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kolleg:innen aus Product und Sales gestaltest du eine Customer Experience, die unsere Kund:innen begeistert. Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Du bearbeitest und priorisierst eingehende Kundenanfragen, löst Probleme zeitnah und eigenständig oder leitest sie strukturiert an die zuständige Customer Success Managerin weiter. Datenqualität sicherstellen: Du pflegst Kundendaten in unseren Systemen, zum Beispiel im CRM, und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher. Reports und QBRs vorbereiten: Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung interner Meetings, Kunden-QBRs und relevanter Reportings. Nach wem wir suchen Dein Hintergrund Du hast ein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit guten Leistungen abgeschlossen. Erste Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von B2B-Kund:innen, in analytischen Tätigkeiten oder in koordinativen Rollen sind von Vorteil. Deine Fähigkeiten Du bist ein Organisationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren. Du verfügst über exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und gehst professionell sowie serviceorientiert auf Kund:innen zu – schriftlich und mündlich. Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich im Umgang mit Zahlen wohl und kannst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher und verständlich kommunizieren. Dein technisches Verständnis Du bist technologieaffin. CRM-Systeme und digitale Tools sind für dich keine Hürde, sondern eine spannende Herausforderung. Erste Erfahrungen in der Energiebranche sind ein Plus. Idealerweise interessierst du dich für erneuerbare Energien und möchtest dich in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln. Deine Sprachkenntnisse Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Du verfügst über fließende Englischkenntnisse. Weitere europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil. Deine ersten 90 Tage: Monat 1: Einarbeitung und Orientierung Du lernst trawas Produkte, Prozesse und den Energiemarkt kennen. Du verstehst, wie Kundenbeziehungen bei trawa funktionieren – vom Onboarding bis zum QBR. Du baust erste Beziehungen zu Kund:innen und internen Stakeholdern auf. Du wirst von erfahrenen Customer Success Manager:innen begleitet und übernimmst erste eigene Aufgaben in der Kundenbetreuung. Monat 2: Erste Verantwortung übernehmen Du übernimmst eigenständig erste Kundenaccounts und wirst zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson für operative Stakeholder. Du arbeitest mit bestehenden Playbooks, QBR-Vorlagen und Tools und wirst zunehmend sicherer in der selbstständigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen und -themen. Monat 3 und danach: Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Bestandskund:innen end to end. Du erkennst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Kund:innen noch besser betreuen und ihre Erfahrungen mit trawa weiter verbessern können. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben. Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte und Kundenerlebnisse, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstands beitragen. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss, und du kannst stolz auf deine Ergebnisse sein. Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Büro fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur, in der wir gerne gemeinsam arbeiten. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls möglich. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und bis zu zehn Workation-Tagen unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche Entwicklung: Du wirst Teil eines tollen Teams, in dem Coaching und Mentoring großgeschrieben werden. Außerdem arbeitest du mit modernen Technologien und lernst von erfahrenen Expert:innen aus der Branche. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • AI-first development using LLMs for code generation, testing, documentation, and design exploration.

  • AI-native product features built into GelatoConnect and the core platform — improving routing, personalization, and production optimization.

  • Able to adapt, change and grow quickly as we scale the organization

  • PostgreSQL, BigQuery, RabbitMQ

Siena is the Agent of Record for consumer brands. One agent that owns the entire customer journey, running on a shared intelligence layer no point tool can replicate.

Consumer brands run ten or more disconnected tools to manage their customers. We collapse that stack into a single agent. It started with support, the hardest surface a brand has, and it expands from there: Shopping Agent, Social Agent, Siena working alongside a brand's own operators. One agent across every surface, with shared memory, shared context, and shared tools.

Hundreds of brands already run real customer volume on Siena in production. This is built, working, and growing, and we are racing to build what comes next.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to own real problems rather than close tickets, keep reading.

The Role
Hiring at Siena is moving fast, and it's about to move faster. So we’re looking for the next athlete to join our Talent Ops team.

You'll own the candidate's first experience of Siena end to end: triage, first screen, feedback, follow-through. You're accountable for the quality and experience of everyone who makes it through your part of the process, as well as the experience of the ones who don't.

Recruiting at Siena is owned, not handed off. You'll stay close to the candidate, close to the Talent Ops Manager, and close to the tools that run the work, so nothing gets lost between hand-offs.

What you'll own

  • Inbound triage and first-round screens across our highest-volume and highest-stakes roles

  • Every candidate's answer, on time. This is the standard the function is built around.

  • Scheduling and logistics across a growing slate of live roles

  • Ashby, kept immaculate. Pipelines, notes, statuses, always current. If it's not clean in Ashby, it didn't happen.

  • AI in your workflow. Claude and tools like it aren't optional; you use them to run the work, not just draft an email

  • Occasional sourcing support when volume calls for it. Outbound stays with the Talent Ops Manager, but you'll pitch in when the moment needs it

What you bring

  • Agency background, whether that meant volume at pace or a handful of searches done with real precision

  • You treat every candidate like a relationship, not a transaction - including the ones who don't move forward.

  • Time at a boutique agency, or a startup at Series A or earlier. You've worked without a playbook and you're comfortable building one

  • Comfortable building real workflows with Claude or similar. This isn't optional here, it's how the job gets done.

This role is not for you if

  • You want a fully scoped queue and clear instructions before you'll act. This role runs on judgment, not a checklist.

  • You think candidate feedback is optional once someone's a no. Here, it's the standard the whole function is built around.

  • You're waiting for the next direction before you'll take real ownership. The ownership is yours, just check on alignment

  • You want to skip the AI tooling and do things the old way because it's familiar. That's not on the table here.

  • You're looking for a pure headhunting or closing role. This is the operational and candidate-experience layer, and it's just as demanding.

  • You need a manager checking your work daily to feel confident it's right. You'll be trusted to run this, and expected to flag it yourself when something's off.

The deal

Six-month fixed-term contract, with potential to transition to a permanent role at the end of the term based on performance and business need

Why Siena?

  • Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

  • Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

  • A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

  • A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

  • Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

  • Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

  • AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.


Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.
