raw.title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
raw.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About the Role:

DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps..

What You'll Own:

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

  • Collaborate with Content, Creative, and Regional Marketing teams to produce and localize campaign assets.

  • Maintain a global campaign calendar and asset library, ensuring brand consistency, messaging alignment, and timely deployment across all touchpoints, and coordinate with owners of other persona tracks (e.g., Product/Eng/Dev) so the portfolio campaign reads as one coherent motion.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team to design and execute ABM programs, building tailored campaign strategies, messaging, and content for prioritized accounts and account tiers.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing and RevOps to feed account engagement, pipeline influence, and conversion data back into ABM targeting and strategy decisions.

  • Continuously refine account segmentation and messaging based on engagement signals, win/loss insights, and sales feedback.

.Measurement & Optimization

  • Drive measurable impact on awareness, adoption, and pipeline; setting and tracking KPIs such as lead quality, conversion rates, account engagement, and ROI.

  • Collaborate with Performance Marketers to initiate data-driven optimization and A/B testing across campaign channels and ABM plays to continuously improve performance.

  • Leverage insights and competitive intelligence to inform campaign strategy, refine positioning, and identify new opportunities in the AI translation market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Foster cross-functional collaboration and campaign excellence, sharing learnings, best practices, and post-mortem analyses to continually improve performance and scalability.

  • Serve as the campaigns subject matter expert, representing campaign and ABM performance in relevant leadership and planning forums.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or ABM roles.

  • Proven track record of managing complex, multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution.

  • Understanding account-based marketing programs, including account tiering, personalized content, and multi-touch orchestration alongside Sales.

  • Demonstrated success driving pipeline generation and revenue growth through integrated and account-based campaigns.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Data-driven decision-making and proficiency in campaign analytics, attribution, and performance optimization.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management, particularly with Sales and SDR teams.

  • AI literacy, including familiarity with GenAI tools for campaign planning, content creation, and execution.

  • Preferred: previous experience in high-growth SaaS companies (Series B–IPO stage).

  • Preferred: experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) in addition to core marketing tech.

Technical Requirements - nice to have:

  • Marketing Automation: HubSpot

  • CRM: Salesforce (or equivalent)

  • ABM Platform: 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar (preferred)

  • Project Management: Asana, Jira, or similar tools

  • Content Management: Contentful or comparable CMS/DAM platforms

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement.
 
Life at TodayTix Group
We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.
 
New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development.

Powered by TodayTix (PxT) is TodayTix Group's enterprise ticketing and e-commerce division — the technology and tools that help the world's leading cultural organisations, attractions, and live events power their box office and drive online sales. We work with some of the most exciting venues, producers, and event organisers on the planet, and we're building the platform that helps them thrive.

This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of client-facing delivery and internal process-building — someone who can own complex implementations end-to-end while also helping define how we do this work as we scale.

As a hands-on leader reporting to the NYC-based Sr. Director of Operations & Implementation, you'll translate signed contracts into successful go-lives. But you'll also bring curiosity and a builder's mindset: experimenting with new tools (including AI), identifying patterns across implementations, and turning lessons learned into better playbooks. You won't always have a defined path — and that's part of what makes this exciting.

We're looking for someone who's ready to grow into greater ownership and autonomy as they prove themselves in the role — this is a role with real room to expand, not a fixed job description.

Please note: This is a full-time position, and qualified candidates must be based in the greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, while also offering flexibility for employees to choose where they work for the rest of the week. Some partners require shifted, 7-day support coverage; this role has a hand in setting and maintaining those schedules, including providing direct coverage where needed. On-site presence for partner onboarding is a shared requirement across the team and should be expected as part of this role.

  • Risk & Issue Management — risks are identified early, communicated clearly, and mitigated before they impact timelines or trust.

  • Lead hands-on technical configuration — partnering on configuration of client websites and microsites, implementing client-specific features, and managing data migrations and system integrations.

  • Train and support clients through launch and beyond — leading enablement so clients can confidently run PxT day to day, then staying engaged post-launch to troubleshoot and cover features outside client self-service.

  • Scope complex projects and manage risk — breaking large initiatives into clear tasks and milestones while proactively surfacing and mitigating issues before they threaten timelines or trust.

  • Identify patterns across implementations — turn them into better process, templates, and tooling — including experimenting with AI and automation — so this role leaves a real mark on how PxT scales delivery.

  • Partner cross-functionally — with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to resolve blockers and ensure clean handoffs at every stage.

  • Demonstrated project management expertise — task definition, timeline ownership, and resource coordination across complex, concurrent projects.

  • Proven experience managing the full lifecycle of software implementations, from contract signing through go-live.

  • Experience directly managing people — setting priorities, giving regular feedback, and supporting professional growth.

  • Experience with ticketing, CRM, or e-commerce systems

  • Excellent client communication and training skills — able to manage expectations, translate complexity, and build trust.

  • A proactive problem-solver with strong risk identification instincts and high attention to detail.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity — able to figure out what "good" looks like without a defined playbook and bring others along.

  • Curiosity about how AI and new tools can improve delivery operations — not required to be an expert, but genuinely interested.

  • Experience in the arts, live events, or attractions industries is a bonus.

In this role, you will work as a key member of the Ads Customer Interfaces team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What is the role?</h3> <p>Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television and streaming media worldwide, continued success stems from experienced software engineers like you developing core features for the Roku platform.</p> <p>Our new Senior Software Engineer will be contributing extensively to our container orchestrated platform, bringing together some of the latest web technologies with Ai expertise to develop a truly scalable and responsive web applications. This is a great role for a senior professional who enjoys a high level of visibility and thrives on great business impact.</p> <p>The features and performance improvements you implement directly impact millions of users every day. This is a great role for an experienced professional who has innovative ideas for complex problems and can translate these ideas into ultra-reliable software.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>How will I use AI at Roku?</h3> <p>&nbsp;<br>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What are the responsiblities of the role?&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and deliver high-quality web applications and back-end services with modern frameworks and technologies.</li> <li>Work as a part of a high functioning team consisting of UX designers, software engineers, dev-ops, quality assurance and product management.</li> <li>Build and integrate AI-powered features into web applications and enterprise tools.</li> <li>Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to power chatbot interactions</li> <li>Work both independently and paired with other team members to ensure efficient delivery of prioritised features.</li> <li>Take part in the planning and refinement of features along with the team to come up with innovative and collaborative designs.</li> <li>Develop new features and write test cases to ensure the quality of your code.</li> <li>Work with CI/CD tools to ensure that all software developed adheres to both quality and scaling requirements.</li> <li>Take a role in continuously improving our software delivery process, making it as efficient as possible, reducing wasteful activities and creating value.</li> <li>See a feature go all the way from design stage to being deployed into customer facing environments.</li> <li>Demonstrate the ability to dig deep to find solutions to challenging problems affecting our users.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive expeirence&nbsp; in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Express) on cloud-based technology, such as AWS and GCP.</li> <li>Experience of building large scale and low latency distributed systems.</li> <li>Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, performance optimisation techniques, object-oriented programming.</li> <li>Experience using modern AI-assisted and agentic development workflows in day-to-day engineering using&nbsp;AI/ML APIs and SDKs</li> <li>Hands-on experience developing RAG solutions or working with LLMs for chatbots is preferred</li> <li>In-depth understanding of CI/CD and the tools used to implement them, such as Jenkins.</li> <li>Experience with software repository tools, such as GitLab and GitHub.</li> <li>Experience with productivity tools, such as Jira and Confluence.</li> <li>A good understanding of Agile practices.</li> <li>Ability to accurately estimate software tasks and work to schedule.</li> <li>Exposure to observability tools and practices (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) are preferred.</li> <li>Understanding of databases and data architecture choices (SQL vs NoSQL, caching layers, and data access patterns)</li> <li>Track record of tuning performance and reliability for highly available services and web applications</li> <li>Familiarity with web security fundamentals and secure engineering practices</li> <li>Bachelors of Masters Degree in Compute Science/Software Engineering or related subject</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-PA1</strong></p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • The problem is real, and the scale is global. The supply chain industry moves $19 trillion of goods a year. We're building the AI workforce that makes it run smarter. Your work will matter.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

title: Director of Product & Tech Delivery
description: <p><strong>Job title: </strong>Director of Product &amp; Tech Delivery<br><strong>Location:</strong> Bristol or London (hybrid)<em><br></em><strong>Salary:</strong> £130,400 - £163,000<br><strong>Team:</strong> Product &amp; Tech Operations<br><strong>Reporting to:</strong> VP Product &amp; Tech Operations</p> <p><em>This role is based in either Bristol or London and requires an existing right to work in the UK.</em></p> <p><em>At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.</em></p> <p>Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.&nbsp;</p> <p>By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.</p> <p>With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen</p> <p><strong>What will I be doing?</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the VP Product &amp; Tech Operations, you’ll own the timely, predictable execution of our Product &amp; Technology roadmap, for Kaluza and for our clients, across our global product, field deployment, and platform foundations teams. You’ll line-manage Heads and Group Delivery Managers, set the standard for how delivery is done across the function, and provide the leadership confidence around what we can deliver, both near-term and further ahead. You’ll move fluently between board-level narrative and the detail of a single stuck dependency.</p> <p><strong>The role spans four focus areas:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Run delivery at scale </strong>- own predictable, end-to-end execution across your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Implementing an AI-native system of wor</strong>k - make AI-assisted delivery the default and raise the bar on how delivery is done, partnering with our P&amp;T business operations team to implement best practices across our product development lifecycle (PDLC) that are designed and standardised by the Business Operations team.</li> <li><strong>Grow an independent, high-performing delivery community</strong> - build a function that solves its own problems, and has a “yes if” attitude to solving the inevitable challenges of the day to day.</li> <li><strong>Partner and Influence at the Executive Level&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Run delivery at scale</strong></span></h1> <p>Own and drive successful delivery across Kaluza’s Product and Tech organisation, typically multiple streams that may align to client programmes or global initiatives.</p> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end delivery of the Product &amp; Tech roadmap across your area, e.g. across multiple client streams (OVO &amp; ENGIE in Europe, AGL &amp; Shell in APAC) or multiple global product streams.</li> <li>Implement evolutions of a standard methodology that allows the business to scale and ensures successful client implementations</li> <li>Drive absolute roadmap alignment, delivery enablement and reporting at multiple levels, from team detail to executive overview.</li> <li>Bring confidence to what we can deliver, near-term and further ahead through robust capacity planning, milestone tracking (actuals vs estimates), forecasting, and proactive management and resolution of cross-team dependencies.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, UX and Client Delivery leadership so deliverables meet client capabilities, support needs and timelines, and so client feedback flows back into the delivery process.</li> <li>Provide objective, data-led neutral insight on how delivery is really going; proactively escalate risks and issues early, and drive decisions with senior leadership and clients.</li> <li>Embed good practices into our internal delivery management practices that are developed by the Business Operations team, and provide input to shape their future roadmap.&nbsp;</li> <li>Deputise for the VP when needed.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Implement an AI-native system of work through delivery</strong></span></h1> <p>Lead the strategic evolution of our delivery practices by embedding AI-assisted methodologies into default operational workflows</p> <ul> <li>Embed AI-assisted delivery into reporting, forecasting, capacity and effort analysis, dependency mapping, risk detection and status communication.</li> <li>Push the boundaries of Jira, JQL and agentic workflows; build dashboards and reporting that drive development forward at pace and replace manual effort.</li> <li>Simplify and standardise practice across Product &amp; Tech: refine ways of working, embed Agile &amp; Lean practice, and raise predictability and the effort-to-value ratio in your area.</li> <li>Act as a change driver, co-own the delivery of a roadmap of improvements to our system of work alongside Business Operations, and bring people with you through the change.</li> <li>Champion continuous improvement and show the function what good, AI-native delivery looks like in practice.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Grow an independent, high-performing delivery community</strong></span></h1> <p>Build a self-sufficient, empowered function that is a gold standard for getting things done, effectively, and with transparency.</p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a group of people leaders and delivery managers, Heads of, Group and Lead) Delivery Managers, setting clear objectives, focus and clarity.</li> <li>Coach the team to navigate complexity and uncertainty, to self-solve, and to bias their effort towards Kaluza’s goals and our client commitments.</li> <li>Know the product and coach the team to understand the product domain for their area so that they can enable cross-functional team delivery of the product roadmap and client delivery goals</li> <li>Mentor and upskill across the community; show the team what good looks like and raise the standard across the board.</li> <li>Clear the barriers that stop Product teams focusing on innovation and strategy, and Engineering teams focusing on technical excellence and execution.</li> <li>Support the Delivery function in achieving its strategy and goals, and champion the wider change and planning agenda.</li> <li>Be an innovative thinker and member of the larger Kaluza SLT team to drive the business forward.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Partner and Influence at the Executive Level&nbsp;</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted partner to Product, Engineering, UX, and Client Delivery leadership, serving as an active member of the Senior Leadership Team (SLT)&nbsp;</li> <li>Confidently manage relationships with C-level clients.&nbsp;</li> <li>Deliver objective tracking, milestone visibility + forecasting, and proactive risk mitigation strategies to leadership, while serving as a strategic deputy for the VP of Product &amp; Tech Operations when required</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <p>You’re an accomplished delivery leader with a strong track record. Ideally, you’ll be:</p> <ul> <li>A builder <em>and</em> an executor: you define what good looks like, take full accountability, and go looking for what you need rather than waiting for a brief.</li> <li>Genuinely AI-native: AI tools feel like leverage, not an afterthought. You have deep curiosity in innovation and AI tools, actively pushing AI adoption into delivery practice.</li> <li>Steady in ambiguity: A nimble leader who thrives in complex undefined spaces, is comfortable diving into problems at multiple altitudes, and the steady presence others rely on when the path isn’t fully defined.</li> <li>Strategic Delivery Leader: An accomplished delivery leader and a bar raiser when it comes to of managing large-scale, cross-functional delivery management functions within a high-growth SaaS environment</li> <li>Experienced leading delivery management at scale: line-managing and developing people leaders, across cross-functional Product &amp; Engineering teams using agile methodologies.</li> <li>Able to design and evolve delivery operating models, governance and ways of working, with an openness to follow current Kaluza practice and refine where needed.</li> <li>A trusted partner: to Product &amp; Engineering leadership, able to influence senior leadership,and credible with C-level clients.</li> <li>A strong listener, people leader <em>and</em> coach: able to empower teams and colleagues to reach their full potential, and to bring people along on a change journey.</li> <li>Fluent with Jira, or similar roadmapping tools, with real curiosity about using JQL and AI to generate dashboards and reporting that drive development at pace.</li> <li>Comfortable switching between team-level detail and executive-level overview, applying the right approach in the right context.</li> <li>Committed to radical candour: you ask hard questions, and give honest developmental feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What will set you apart</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience managing delivery frameworks across major global energy utility accounts or multi-regional client programmes.</li> <li>A proven background or curiosity in implementing an AI-integrated Product Development Lifecycle alongside business operations teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Where you'll work</strong></p> <p>We offer flexible working, with a requirement of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.</p> <p><strong>Kaluza Values</strong></p> <p>Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:</p> <p><strong><em>Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.</em></strong></p> <p><strong>Our Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Pension Scheme</li> <li>Discretionary Bonus Scheme</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> <li>Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app</li> <li>Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests</li> <li>Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts</li> <li>5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most</li> <li>26 days holiday + bank holidays</li> <li>Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including up to 26 weeks full pay for primary caregivers and 4 weeks full pay for secondary caregivers when welcoming a new addition to your family.</li> <li>Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!</li> <li>Home Office Budget</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> <p><strong>We want the best people</strong></p> <p>We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life. Our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.</p> <p>We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.</p> <p>Find out more about working in <a href="http://kaluza.com">Kaluza</a> on our <a href="https://kaluza-dev.webflow.io/careers">careers page</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/">LinkedIn</a>. <br><br>You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy <a href="https://www.kaluza.com/applicant-data-protection-notice">here</a>.</p> <p><br><br><br></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We care deeply about hiring excellence and finding people who truly elevate our teams. For us, recruitment is a team sport - we win together, constantly looking at how we can improve and bounce ideas off each other, and always step in to help whenever someone gets stuck or hits a wall.</p> <p>Our<strong> Consumer Mission </strong>- building the <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sumup.pay&amp;hl=en">SumUp App</a> - is scaling fast and we’re looking for a Senior Tech TA Partner to help the team navigate London’s hyper-competitive market, where top engineers are in high demand.Your superpower will be understanding how to position SumUp's massive scale and impact to passive talent. You must have the right to work in the UK to be considered.<br><br></em></p> <h2>Why you should join SumUp</h2> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central Covent Garden location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
description: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.</p> <p>As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll help answer questions such as:</p> <ul> <li>Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?</li> <li>Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?</li> <li>What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?</li> <li>Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?</li> <li>How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?</li> </ul> <p>If you’re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from <strong>acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation</strong>.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.</li> <li>Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.</li> <li>Support decisions that improve key business Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The Team

We are currently seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Payments & Blockchain team to be focused on our payments systems. The Payments & Blockchain team is responsible for the first and last mile of every dollar (digital or fiat) that goes in or out of Kraken.

Join our Payments team to help integrate Kraken’s systems with an ever-expanding universe of payment providers.

As a member of this team, your focus is on protecting client funds. You will be responsible for building systems that communicate with various blockchains to enable the timely processing of client transactions, while also ensuring the safety and security of all funds on the exchange.

 

The Opportunity

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality payment processing systems using React.js and other relevant technologies

  • Build and refine seamless transaction experiences that optimize fund transfers for speed, security, and reliability

  • Ensure an efficient and intuitive onboarding experience for users interacting with payment systems, reducing friction and improving trust

  • Develop innovative features that enhance engagement, retention, and loyalty within the payments ecosystem

  • Set the standard for high-quality, secure code and lead the development of complex financial software systems

  • Influence technical decisions, contribute to strategy discussions, and shape product/domain decisions with a deep understanding of financial systems and security best practices

  • Mentor engineers, foster a culture of technical excellence, and drive process improvements in financial software development

  • Design and implement scalable, maintainable, and fault-tolerant financial systems, ensuring compliance and security best practices

 

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on web and mobile applications

  • Deep understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and proficiency with React and React Native frameworks

  • Experience with Next.js, RESTful APIs and WebSockets

  • Experience with frontend testing frameworks

  • Familiarity with modern front-end build pipelines and tooling

  • Strong understanding of UI/UX best practices and principles

  • Experience within a large technology organization or fast growing startup

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

 

Nice to haves

  • Knowledge of the cryptocurrency industry and blockchain technology

 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Account Manager, DACH
description: About Us Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco. We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. About You: You are a German speaking Account Manager, excited to join a growing team focused on demonstrating ownership of our clients’ experience from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You will work closely with members of the Customer Success team, Sales team, and other internal Constructor teams to support and grow your book of business. You are an advocate for your customer and work with internal teams to provide feedback to Product, create advocacy opportunities for Marketing, and visibility into use cases and customer health for the organization. You demonstrate a high degree of accountability and ownership. Responsibilities: You are the strategic lead for the clients in your book of business. You will build strong relationships with your clients in order to understand their business goals, business needs, the priorities of these goals and needs, and how Constructor maps to these goals and needs. You will manage complex, enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from start to finish – effectively demonstrating the product and the business and economic benefits to each stakeholder (from business champion to the C-Suite level). You will uncover and manage risk within your book of business in a timely and effective manner. You will grow to be well versed on your clients’ business needs and the Constructor product in order to educate clients on potential new use cases, features and integrations that create added value and uncover potential upsell opportunities. You will regularly update internal systems and attend internal meetings in order to document and communicate customer status, needs, risk, renewal next steps, and upsell next steps. Basic Requirements: Minimum of 3+ Years of proven experience working directly with large enterprise clients a role within Account Management, Customer Success, and/or Sales within a SaaS company, preferably one that works directly with ecommerce clients. German Language skills are a MUST! Proven ability to influence, present to, and build deep relationships with our customers, especially at the VP+ level. Proven ability to uncover and properly manage risk within your book of business in a timely and effective manner. Proven ability to educate clients on new use cases, features and integrations that create added value and uncover potential upsell opportunities. Proven ability in managing complex, enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from start to finish – effectively demonstrating the product and the business and economic benefits to each stakeholder (from business champion to the C-Suite level). Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding individual retention and expansion goals. Attend and ensure the success of Quarterly Business Reviews with Customers to ensure understanding of client goals and how Constructor maps to those goals. Proven ability to juggle multiple Account Management projects and recurring responsibilities at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail. Proven ability to work cross functionally with various teams to meet the aforementioned needs and goals of your clients - this includes, but is not limited to, working with Sales, CSMs, SEs, SAs, Data Science teams, Product+Eng teams. This includes the ability to tailor language and asks for these teams while maintaining an eye on timeline, SLAs, and the overall client goals and needs. Solid knowledge and understanding of ecommerce business needs - typical goals, KPIs, terminology, and trends. Solid understanding of analytics and statistics, with an ideal focus on being able to analyze and present data sets pertaining to ecommerce, ab testing, and conversion. Proven ability to acquire and maintain a working knowledge of the complete capabilities of Constructor’s ever-evolving products and capabilities. About the Position

As a Technical Support Engineer on our EMEA team, you’ll be part of the support-founding team, a reliable technical resource for enterprise customers, helping them troubleshoot issues, understand Constructor behavior, and move forward with confidence. You’ll own and drive customer-facing technical support conversations across tickets, Slack, and calls, especially for issues involving Constructor APIs, SDKs, data integrations, event instrumentation, tagging, and implementation behavior. You'll act as a supportive partner, bridging the gap between technical issues and successful resolutions, ensuring customers feel supported throughout each interaction.You’ll investigate technical hurdles, communicate clearly while work is in progress, coordinate with internal teams when escalation is needed, and make sure customers understand the resolution and next steps.

You can dive into a payload or a log review, drive technical implementation guides and communicate clear solutions in tickets with equal ease, but consistently earning trust within every interaction is what sets you apart. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys technical problem-solving, high-quality customer communication, and improving the systems that help a support team scale.

  • Provide clear, timely, and technically sound support on complex inbound questions involving Constructor APIs, SDKs, data integrations, tagging, event instrumentation, and implementation behavior.

  • Earn trust across technical and business stakeholders by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and distilling complex technical issues into simple, actionable next steps.

  • Troubleshoot issues by reviewing payloads, logs, API behavior, configuration, and implementation details, then guiding customers toward a resolution.

  • Support in creating and maintaining knowledge base and documentation.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Constructor’s technical architecture, helping customers understand expected behavior, integration options, and how to troubleshoot issues in their environment.

  • Translate customer issues into clear internal context for Product and Engineering, including impact, reproduction steps, examples, urgency, and customer-facing implications.

  • Create and improve reusable technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, macros, internal notes, and support workflows that help the team resolve issues more consistently and efficiently.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Solutions, Product, and Engineering so customers receive consistent guidance and internal teams have the context they need.

  • Continuously improve support processes, playbooks, and escalation paths to reduce friction, improve response quality, and help customers get to value faster.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in a technical support, technical account management, solutions engineering, implementation, or customer-facing engineering role.

  • Hands-on experience working with APIs, SDKs, logs, HTTP requests, event data, and technical implementation details.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, especially in tickets, Slack, and customer calls, with the ability to explain technical complexity in simple, actionable language.

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers, including situations with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and high urgency.

  • Ability to manage customer expectations, communicate clearly under pressure, and drive issues forward across internal and external teams.

  • Track record of building or improving support processes, documentation, troubleshooting guides, or tooling that improves team efficiency and customer outcomes.

  • Proven ability to manage complex technical support cases from intake to resolution, balancing speed, accuracy, customer communication, and internal escalation when needed.

  • Strong desire to learn quickly, adapt, and improve how we support customers in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Familiarity with JavaScript-based web integrations, HTTP request flows, browser developer tools, and client-side / server-side contexts is a plus, but customer communication, not coding, is your superpower.

  • Ability to support customers during EMEA business hours.

  • Bonus: familiarity with A/B testing, ecommerce search or discovery, network request routing, and HTTP troubleshooting.

title: Data Engineer
description: About Us   IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners.  At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career.  As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.   Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect. IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group. As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout. The role The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process. You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy. What you'll bring to the role We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include: Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital. You should be confident working within an Agile framework, with an understanding of secure development practices and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and access management. An international mindset, sensitivity to local business priorities, and a collaborative approach are essential. What’s in it for you?   At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:  A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation  Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond  Ongoing learning and development supported by tailored programmes and resources  A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement  Flexible working with a remote first working policy Benefits   Healthcare Cash Plan  Cycle to Work scheme  Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme  Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you  Discounted staff pet care   Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers    Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging   At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group.

As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout.

The role

The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process.

You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy.

What you'll bring to the role

We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include:

  • Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles
  • PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing
  • Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps
  • Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role
  • ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols
  • Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles

Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital.

raw.title: Workplace Program & Resource Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

The Workplace Program Manager is responsible for leading and scaling the programs that span Legora's Workplace organization — the initiatives that help employees move faster, have a better day-to-day experience, and keep our offices running within budget as we grow into new markets. This role operates across functions and geographies, owning programs end-to-end while building the structure, processes, and tools that let the Workplace team operate consistently and at scale without slowing down.

This is a cross-functional role that requires strong program management fundamentals, independent judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. You'll work closely with the Workplace team — Managers, Coordinators, and Design/Build — to turn their vision for what a great office experience looks like into programs that are actually launched, adopted, and improving over time. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-growing environments, skilled at building clarity and alignment, and motivated by improving how the Workplace team delivers for employees globally.

If you love the moment a good idea becomes a program employees actually notice and love, this is your role.

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage a portfolio of cross-functional Workplace programs with global scope, driving delivery from scoping through launch, ongoing operation, and continuous improvement

  • Collaborate deeply with Regional Workplace Managers and Workplace Managers to design programs, events and experiences that make employees' day-to-day faster and better — from travel to winter parties and physical security

  • Develop and maintain program-level processes, playbooks, and operating standards that let the Workplace team deliver consistently across regions and offices

  • Lead cross-functional workstreams in partnership with Real Estate, Finance, IT, and Security, ensuring Workplace priorities are clearly represented, aligned, and delivered

  • Identify gaps in current programs and proactively design and launch solutions, often without an established playbook

  • Build and scale tooling, workflows, and internal resources that improve team effectiveness and the consistency of the employee-facing experience

  • Own the budget for programs under your management — building the business case, tracking spend against plan, and flagging drift before it becomes a problem

  • Manage vendor relationships and provide direction where relevant to program delivery, ensuring alignment to Legora's standards

  • Help monitor and control budget across the broader Workplace portfolio, and step in to unblock global procurement and vendor issues as they come up

  • Serve as a thought partner to Workplace leadership on priorities, team capacity, and program strategy

  • Communicate clearly across all levels of the organization, translating complex operational topics into guidance employees actually understand

Who You Are

  • You get energy from watching an idea become something employees actually use and love

  • You'd rather build the plan yourself than wait for someone to hand you a template

  • You partner well — you make the Workplace team's vision better, not just execute it

  • You move fast without losing sight of the budget or the details that make a program actually work

  • You're motivated by impact on real people's day-to-day experience, not just ticking off a delivery date

What We're Looking For

  • 5–8+ years designing, launching, or running employee-facing programs — workplace, people ops, program management, or a related field

  • A track record of taking a program from idea to launch, including owning the budget

  • Experience improving or relaunching an existing program based on data or feedback, not just building new ones

  • Comfort partnering across Real Estate, Finance, IT, and Security without needing a governance structure to get things moving

  • Global or multi-office experience is a plus, but not required

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
